findings.detail: The first green implementation returned the complete record content beside the bounded excerpt, defeating the dual-budget result boundary. The field was removed and a regression now checks both the absent key and absent full body.

unverified_scope: The retrieval core is not wired to a CLI, Session, memory tool, prompt or checkpoint. Full-suite behavior, real v1/v2 stores, real provider usage, semantic retrieval quality, concurrent readers, Windows/Linux execution, packaging, installation, tag, Release and package-index actions were not run.

landing_sign_off.scope: Landing this exact medium-risk candidate on main; no tag, Release, package upload, real provider run or retrieval prompt injection.

why: This is a medium-risk Python behavior slice: it adds a closed retrieval result contract with admission, ranking, budget and continuation semantics.
not_doing: No CLI, Session, tool, prompt or checkpoint wiring; no default search change; no provider call; no vector index; no publication action.
diff_walk: pocketchat/memory_retrieval.py: validate v2 records, gate workspace/admission/sensitive/expiry state before matching, tokenize English words and CJK bigrams under a fixed version, rank deterministically, bound UTF-8 excerpts by byte and estimated-token quotas, and bind stable cursors to ordered record signatures.

tests/test_memory_retrieval.py: cover pre-ranking admission, exclusion reasons, bilingual normalization, ordered ranking, independent budgets, full-content omission, stable pagination and stale cursors, and distinct empty versus budget-exhausted outcomes.
docs/memory-retrieval.md and docs/memory-retrieval.zh-CN.md: fix the normalization, ranking, budget, result and continuation contract without claiming semantic relevance or live integration.
docs/compatibility.md and docs/compatibility.zh-CN.md: mark the result as an unreleased additive candidate and preserve the legacy search promise.
docs/slice-queue.md and CHANGELOG.md: record the delivered pure slice and its evidence without claiming a release.
static_checks: Admission exclusions are decided before query scoring and Top-K selection.
The result contains a bounded excerpt and digest but no complete memory content.
The tokenizer version and ordering rules are explicit and input-order independent.
UTF-8 prefixes never split a code point, and byte/token counters describe only included excerpts.
Cursor decoding is strict and stale when query or ordered record signatures change.
The module does not import Session, CLI, provider, filesystem store or tool result wiring.
red_green: The initial contract run failed all seven cases with NotImplementedError, then the implementation made them pass.
A subsequent full-content regression failed because item JSON carried the whole body beside the excerpt; removing that field made the regression pass.
Two fixture expectations were corrected after observing the actual specified behavior: bilingual partial coverage may return both records, and an eight-byte excerpt includes two ASCII x characters.
review_notes: Author self-review is recorded; a separate fresh-context review was not run in this turn. Landing remains blocked on human sign-off.
gaps: Full-suite and downstream integration evidence remain absent because the core is intentionally unwired.
